name: Push Up Training Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Push Up Training Simulator where you explore the map to uncover push up techniques and train your body to the fullest.

- Tap to equip your training tool or press "1" then click anywhere to start training
- Click or tap the white box to choose stronger push up techniques to perform
- Search for your next push up techniques using "[ Rank ]" to see their requirements

: Discover new push up techniques around the map
: Get stronger to learn new push up forms
: Achieve higher strength and obtain stronger ranks
: Push up to become better and stronger
: Compete other players and become the strongest

Start your journey now and master the push ups!
